title: A True Crime Walking Tour Through Downtown Dallas
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We are Dallas locals, who have researched the history of your city: the good, the bad, and the ugly. 

We tell your tales with passion, humor, and respect. 

Your tour is a true crime tour, we don't trivialize your stories with conspiracies and ghosts. We tell the stories as they happened, and how they shaped your society.
